_meta.definition: The process of managing purchase orders, including tracking, modification, and fulfillment.

Purchasing PurchaseOrderDetail._description: Tracks individual line items for purchase orders, including product details, quantities, prices, and statuses in the purchasing process.

columns.name: PurchaseOrderID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Purchasing PurchaseOrderDetail

columns.name: PurchaseOrderDetailID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Purchasing PurchaseOrderDetail

columns.name: DueDate
columns.description: Stores scheduled delivery dates for purchase order details.

columns.name: OrderQty
columns.description: Stores the quantity of each item ordered in a purchase order.

columns.name: ProductID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Product entity

columns.name: UnitPrice
columns.description: Stores the individual item prices (in decimal format) for each line item in a purchase order.

columns.name: LineTotal
columns.description: Stores individual line amounts for identical purchases in the Purchasing PurchaseOrderDetail table.

columns.name: ReceivedQty
columns.description: Stores the quantity of each purchased item received.

columns.name: RejectedQty
columns.description: Stores quantity of items rejected during purchase order detail processing.

columns.name: StockedQty
columns.description: Stored are initial quantities of items in a purchase order.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamps of detail row modifications within Purchasing Order transactions.
